instructions.name: create
expected_state_changes: creates a new bonding curve account with initial virtual reserves
creates a new SPL token mint for the memecoin
risk_rules: create is mint-launch: no user funds move
mint must be a fresh uninitialized account
RISK: user-supplied mint address — verify owner is SPL Token after CPI

instructions.name: buy
expected_state_changes: credits accounts.user_token_account with computed token amount
risk_rules: swap-shaped: SOL in, tokens out — validate amount vs curve reserves
user_token_account must be owned by accounts.user
bonding_curve must be the curve PDA for the mint
RISK: if output token amount underflows expected, flag HiddenTransfer

instructions.name: buy_v2
expected_state_changes: credits accounts.user_token_account with computed token amount
risk_rules: swap-shaped: SOL in, tokens out — validate amount vs curve reserves
user_token_account must be owned by accounts.user

instructions.name: buy_exact_sol_in
expected_state_changes: credits accounts.user_token_account with computed token amount
risk_rules: swap-shaped: exact SOL in, tokens out — validate curve math
user_token_account must be owned by accounts.user

instructions.name: sell
risk_rules: swap-shaped: tokens in, SOL out — validate curve math
user_token_account must be owned by accounts.user
RISK: if sell output is drained to an attacker address instead of accounts.user, flag CompositionalDrain

instructions.name: sell_v2
risk_rules: swap-shaped: tokens in, SOL out — validate curve math
user_token_account must be owned by accounts.user

instructions.name: migrate
expected_state_changes: migrates bonding curve liquidity to a DEX pool (e.g. Raydium CPMM)
sets mint authority / freezes bonding curve state
risk_rules: RISK: migration moves LP — verify pool recipient is a known DEX program
RISK: authority is program PDA — flag if authority is a user key
RISK: if LP tokens are transferred to an attacker account, flag CompositionalDrain

instructions.name: initialize
expected_state_changes: initializes the global program state account
risk_rules: admin-only: authority must be the known deployer key
one-time: global_state must be uninitialized

instructions.name: set_params
risk_rules: admin-only: authority must be the known deployer key
RISK: parameter change by unknown authority — flag PermissionEscalation
